notes.zh-CN: 修复桌面首页的开场建议偶尔显示 DSML 工具调用标签或命令参数的问题。无法提取有效建议时，首页会显示当前语言的默认建议。macOS 为 universal 开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Fix an issue where desktop starter suggestions could show DSML tool-call tags or command arguments. The welcome screen shows localized defaults when no valid suggestions are available. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
